name: jump-jump-game
description: Doc tooling for this repository (JSDoc -> Markdown)

scripts.docs:api: npm run docs:api:watermark && npm run docs:api:game
scripts.docs:check: FAIL_ON_MISSING=1 npm run docs:jsdoc:scan && FAIL_ON_MISSING=1 npm run docs:py:scan
scripts.docs:all: npm run docs:api && npm run docs:jsdoc:scan && npm run docs:jsdoc:stubs && npm run docs:py:scan
